# AI-Driven Development — Repository Context

This repository is a personal **practice system** for building software with
AI as a working partner. It contains documents, instruction samples, and
plugins — not a framework or library.

## What this repo is

- Markdown documents describing practices (`docs/practices/`)
- Detailed specs for specific quality methods (`docs/methods/`)
- Copilot/Claude plugins (`plugins/<plugin-name>/`)
- Top-level catalogs for standalone AI artifact samples
  (`agents/`, `skills/`, `hooks/`, `instructions/`, `prompts/`)
- Open source under CC BY 4.0

## What this repo is NOT

- Not a framework, library, or installable package
- Not tied to any specific language, platform, or protocol
- Not a single methodology — it is a set of practices addressing distinct
  problems across a project's lifecycle

## How to work with this repo

- Follow the principles in `docs/practices/002-principles.md`: brief, alive,
  structured, opinionated, enforceable
- One concept per file. Replace outdated content — do not append history
- Keep docs short enough to read in one sitting
- Every recommendation should have a clear position
- Use plain language. No marketing copy, no filler

## Repository structure

- `docs/practices/` — Lifecycle practice docs (001-017, problem → approach)
- `docs/methods/` — Deep specs for specific quality methods
- `plugins/<name>/` — Cross-tool plugins (skills, agents, manifests)
- `instructions/`, `agents/`, `skills/`, `hooks/`, `prompts/` —
  Top-level artifact sample catalogs
- `.github/` — GitHub config and this repo's own AI instructions

## Companion

The blog at https://givikdev.github.io/ai-driven-development/ provides concise
summaries of each section and links back here for full documentation.
